CHAPTER 999 - SAMPLE TITLE

NRS 999.010 Definitions.

NRS 999.020 Gadget registration; fees.

NRS 999.0215 Widget inspection.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

NRS 999.010  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, “gadget” means a small device described in NRS 999.020 and “widget” means a larger device.

(Added to NRS by 1960, 235; A 1971, 100)

REGISTRATION

NRS 999.020  Gadget registration; fees.  1. Each owner of a gadget shall register it with the Secretary of Gadgets within 30 days.

2. The fee for registration is $5 per gadget.

(Added to NRS by 1965, 12)

NRS 999.0215  Widget inspection.  A widget must be inspected once each year by an authorized inspector.

(Added to NRS by 1999, 77)
